clips.title: The story
paras: The Swamp of Sorrows is a murky, brackish wetland tucked between Deadwind Pass and the arid Blasted Lands. Once the northern expanse of the ancient Black Morass, its salt-crusted bogs are home to dangerous wildlife, green dragonspawn, and the ruined Temple of Atal'Hakkar sunken beneath the Pool of Tears. While the Horde maintains the fortified garrison of Stonard, the Alliance has no safe haven within the mire, leaving the wilderness largely untamed.

Long before the coming of the Orcish Horde, these marshes formed the northern half of an enormous wetlands known as the Black Morass. Following the shattering of the Gurubashi Empire, the fanatical Atal'ai trolls fled into the mire to erect the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, intending to summon their bloodthirsty loa, Hakkar the Soulflayer. Sensing the catastrophe, the Aspect Ysera unleashed her powers, drowning the cursed pyramid beneath the waters of the Pool of Tears. Green dragonflight guardians led by Eranikus were stationed to vigilantly watch over the drowned structure. When the Dark Portal's cataclysm later scorched the southern morass into the Blasted Lands, this northern fen earned its current sorrowful name.

Stonard serves as the primary civilized foothold in the swamp. Originally established during the First War alongside the now-ruined settlements of Rockard and Kyross, the outpost was rebuilt under Thrall to serve as the Horde's southernmost staging ground in the Eastern Kingdoms. Beyond Stonard's palisades, strange wanderers roam the fen. A group of draenei stragglers stranded on Azeroth succumbed to homesickness and madness, degenerating into feral Lost Ones. However, a small enclave of lucid Broken exiles persists at the Harborage, wary but willing to trade peacefully with travelers.

Surviving the swamp requires constant vigilance against its predatory wildlife. Deep bogs hide lunging crocolisks, venomous spiders, prowling swamp jaguars, and wandering bog beasts encrusted with marsh debris. Coastal caverns and the Misty Reed Strand crawl with vicious murlocs, while the salt-laden tide creeps continually inland, preserving rotten logs in thick briny crusts. Farther east lies Sorrowmurk, where aggressive elite dragonspawn fiercely guard the approaches to the Sunken Temple, attacking anyone who strays near their vigil.
